13                SENATOR FARLEY:   Just to explain my 

14   vote.

15                My colleagues, this is Library Day.  

16   And this is a major priority of the Library 

17   Association of New York State.  And it involves 

18   the Construction Fund, and it is very, very 

19   important for anybody.  

20                And I know that this Senate has been 

21   so supportive of libraries.  I appreciate your 

22   support.  It's very, very important.  This is a 

23   good bill.  So when you see your librarian today, 

24   you can tell them you voted for it.
